patronOf.pt-BR: Padroeiro da Boêmia e da Polônia

prayerExcerpt.en-US: This Saint went as far as death, handing over his life to destruction for the work of Christ.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Este santo, pela causa do Cristo, arriscou a própria vida até à morte.

meta.face: A tall, lean Czech of about forty with an ANGULAR, high-cheekboned face narrowing to a firm, POINTED chin — a broad, straight forehead, strong, jutting cheekbones over slightly hollow cheeks, a straight nose with a broad base, deep-set, earnest blue-grey eyes under straight fair brows, a thin, firm mouth; straight ash-blond hair cut short around a tonsure; a short fair beard lying close along the jaw and ending in a small point at the chin; a fervent gaze toward the distance.
meta.basis: No likeness survives, and the later tradition paints him as a white-bearded elder, though he was killed at about forty. The card makes him the age he was, with a fair Slavic face of our choice, and sets him above his cathedral city of Prague rather than at his martyrdom.
